text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Victory is ours! Cry out in triumph!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It's a glorious victory for none other 
than me, No Reason!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha! Trainer, was that not a 
splendid battle?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My charge will continue unabated from here 
on! Burn the sight into your memory!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run wild in the next battle too! 
Time for an uprising!
choice_data_list: I shall follow you, Lord No Reason!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "I'll take the lead! Don't fall behind!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Such an unshakeable spirit, unaffected by 
the atmosphere—truly admirable! However, I 
am no fool either!"

text_block_list.text:
Complacency is an enemy we must guard 
against above all else! Let's stay sharp 
and take the next victory too!
